disqualifications.rural_unoccupied: Faochadh Tuineachaidh Dùthchail: Dì-cheadaichte — togalach gun ghabhail (feumaidh faochadh dùthchail èigneachail gabhaltas barrantaichte) [LGFA 1988 e.43(6B) / Achd 1975 Clàr 1A].
disqualifications.rural_rv_cap: Faochadh Tuineachaidh Dùthchail: Dì-cheadaichte — tha Luach Measaidh (£{rv}) a' dol thairis air a' chrìoch reachdail de {cap_str} airson {cat} [{authority}].
disqualifications.rural_zero_net: Faochadh Tuineachaidh Dùthchail: Gun a chur an sàs — lughdaich faochaidhean roimhe a' bhuailteachd ghlan gu £0.00.
disqualifications.rural_default: Rural Settlement Relief: Disqualified — statutory qualification criteria not satisfied [{authority}].
disqualifications.sbrr_unoccupied: Sgeama Bònas Gnìomhachasan Beaga: Dì-cheadaichte — togalach falamh (feumaidh SBBS gabhaltas gnìomhach barrantaichte) [Achd Riaghaltas Ionadail (Alba) 1975 / SSI 2023/45].
disqualifications.sbrr_england_rv_cap: Faochadh Ìrean Gnìomhachasan Beaga: Dì-cheadaichte — tha Luach Measaidh (£{rv}) a' dol thairis air mullach reachdail £15,000 [LGFA 1988 e.43(4B) / S.I. 2017/411].
disqualifications.sbrr_england_zero_net: Small Business Rate Relief: Not applied — prior reliefs reduced net payable liability to £0.00.
disqualifications.sbrr_england_default: Small Business Rate Relief: Disqualified — rateable value exceeds threshold for rating list period.
disqualifications.sbrr_wales_rv_cap: Faochadh Gnìomhachasan Beaga na Cuimrigh: Dì-cheadaichte — tha Luach Measaidh (£{rv}) a' dol thairis air mullach reachdail £12,000 [DCLL(C) 2024].
disqualifications.sbrr_wales_zero_net: Small Business Rate Relief (Wales): Not applied — prior reliefs reduced net payable liability to £0.00.
disqualifications.sbrr_wales_default: Small Business Rate Relief (Wales): Disqualified — rateable value exceeds threshold for rating list period.
disqualifications.sbrr_scotland_rv_cap: Sgeama Bònas Gnìomhachasan Beaga (SBBS): Dì-cheadaichte — tha Luach Measaidh (£{rv}) a' dol thairis air mullach reachdail £20,000 [Achd Ìrean Neo-Dachaigheil (Alba) 2020 / SSI 2023/45].
disqualifications.sbrr_scotland_zero_net: Small Business Bonus Scheme (SBBS): Not applied — prior reliefs reduced net payable liability to £0.00.
disqualifications.sbrr_scotland_default: Small Business Bonus Scheme (SBBS): Disqualified — rateable value exceeds threshold for rating list period.
disqualifications.rhl_unoccupied: Faochadh Reic, Aoigheachd agus Cur-seachad: Dì-cheadaichte — togalach falamh (feumaidh gabhaltas gnìomhach).
disqualifications.rhl_england_2026_plus: Reic, Aoigheachd agus Cur-seachad: Air a chur an àite iomadair sràide àrd reachdail nas ìsle ({rate} air a chur an sàs gu h-àrd) — thàinig an lasachadh ceudad gu crìch 31 Màrt 2026 [NDRA 2023].
disqualifications.rhl_england_zero_net: Retail, Hospitality & Leisure Relief: Not applied — 100% relief already granted by prior reliefs.
disqualifications.rhl_england_default: Retail, Hospitality & Leisure Relief: Not eligible under scheme rules for this rating period.
disqualifications.rhl_wales_petrol_excluded: Faochadh Aoigheachd na Cuimrigh: Dì-cheadaichte — tha stèiseanan peatrail (SCAT 211) air an dùnadh a-mach fo riaghailtean na Cuimrigh [DCLL(C) 2024].
disqualifications.rhl_wales_2026_retail_multiplier_exclude: Faochadh Aoigheachd Bidhe is Deoch na Cuimrigh: Air a dhì-cheadachadh — tha oighreachdan fo iomadachair reic na Cuimrigh air an dùnadh a-mach gu reachdail fo riaghailtean sgeama Riaghaltas na Cuimrigh.
disqualifications.rhl_wales_2026_accommodation_excluded: Faochadh Aoigheachd Bidhe is Deoch na Cuimrigh: Air a dhì-cheadachadh — tha gnìomhachasan àite-fuirich (taighean-òsta, dachaighean saor-làithean, làraichean carabhanaichean) air an dùnadh a-mach gu reachdail fo riaghailtean sgeama Riaghaltas na Cuimrigh.
disqualifications.rhl_wales_2026_retail_goods_excluded: Faochadh Aoigheachd Bidhe is Deoch na Cuimrigh: Air a dhì-cheadachadh — tha reic bathar reic (bùthan, mòr-bhùthan) air an dùnadh a-mach gu reachdail fo riaghailtean sgeama Riaghaltas na Cuimrigh.
disqualifications.rhl_wales_2026_not_food_drink: Faochadh Aoigheachd Bidhe is Deoch na Cuimrigh: Air a dhì-cheadachadh — chan eilear a' cleachdadh na h-oighreachd gu tur no sa mhòr-chuid airson aoigheachd bidhe is deoch iomchaidh (taighean-seinnse, taighean-bìdh, cafaidhean) fo riaghailtean sgeama Riaghaltas na Cuimrigh.
disqualifications.rhl_wales_zero_net: Welsh Hospitality Relief: Not applied — prior reliefs reduced net payable liability to £0.00.
disqualifications.rhl_wales_default: Welsh Hospitality Relief: Disqualified — hereditament already receives 100% small business rate relief or not qualifying.
disqualifications.rhl_scotland_rv_cap: Faochadh RHL na h-Alba: Dì-cheadaichte — tha Luach Measaidh (£{rv}) a' dol thairis air crìoch tìr-mòr na h-Alba de £100,000 [Achd Ìrean 2020].
disqualifications.rhl_scotland_not_island: Faochadh RHL na h-Alba: Dì-cheadaichte — chan eil an togalach air eilean Albannach (faochadh 100% cuibhrichte gu eileanan) [Achd nan Eilean (Alba) 2018].
disqualifications.rhl_scotland_zero_net: Scottish RHL Relief: Not applied — prior reliefs reduced net liability to £0.00.
disqualifications.rhl_scotland_default: Scottish RHL Relief: Not eligible under scheme rules for this financial year.
disqualifications.charity_unoccupied: Faochadh Carthannais Èigneachail: Dì-cheadaichte — togalach falamh (feumaidh faochadh carthannais 80% gabhaltas barrantaichte) [Achd 1962 e.4(2)].
disqualifications.charity_zero_net: Mandatory Charitable Relief: Not applied — prior reliefs reduced net payable liability to £0.00.
disqualifications.charity_default: Mandatory Charitable Relief: Not applied under statutory rules.
disqualifications.charity_topup_not_qualifying: Top-Up Carthannais Fo Ùghdarras: Dì-cheadaichte — feumaidh teisteanas airson Faochadh Carthannais Èigneachail 80% [LGFA 1988 e.47(2)(a)].
disqualifications.charity_topup_zero_net: Discretionary Charitable Top-Up: Not applied — net liability already reduced to £0.00.
disqualifications.charity_topup_default: Discretionary Charitable Top-Up: Disqualified — mandatory relief not active.
disqualifications.improvement_not_england: Faochadh Leasachaidh (Fachtor-G): Dì-cheadaichte — Tha Faochadh Leasachaidh a' buntainn ann an Sasainn agus a' Chuimrigh a-mhàin [Non-Domestic Rating Act 2023 s.1 / LGFA 1988 Sched 4ZA].
disqualifications.improvement_before_2024: Faochadh Leasachaidh (Fachtor-G): Dì-cheadaichte — Bidh faochadh reachdail a' tòiseachadh bho 1 Giblean 2024 [Non-Domestic Rating Act 2023].
disqualifications.improvement_after_2029: Faochadh Leasachaidh (Fachtor-G): Dì-cheadaichte — Bidh faochadh reachdail a' tighinn gu crìch ro 1 Giblean 2029 [LGFA 1988 Sched 4ZA para 3].
disqualifications.improvement_unoccupied: Faochadh Leasachaidh (Fachtor-G): Dì-cheadaichte — feumar sealbhachadh leantainneach iomchaidh.
disqualifications.improvement_zero_net: Faochadh Leasachaidh (Fachtor-G): Cha deach a chur an sàs — tha buailteachd lom mar-thà air a lughdachadh gu £0.00.
disqualifications.improvement_default: Faochadh Leasachaidh (Fachtor-G): Gun a bhith airidh fo riaghailtean reachdail.
disqualifications.heat_network_not_england: Saoradh Lìonra Teasa: Dì-cheadaichte — Tha saoradh 100% a' buntainn ann an Sasainn agus a' Chuimrigh a-mhàin [Non-Domestic Rating Act 2023 s.2].
disqualifications.heat_network_before_2024: Saoradh Lìonra Teasa: Dì-cheadaichte — Bidh faochadh reachdail a' tòiseachadh bho 1 Giblean 2024 [Non-Domestic Rating Act 2023 s.19(2)].
disqualifications.heat_network_after_2035: Saoradh Lìonra Teasa: Dì-cheadaichte — Bidh faochadh reachdail a' tighinn gu crìch ro 1 Giblean 2035 [LGFA 1988 Sched 4ZA para 6].
disqualifications.heat_network_unoccupied: Saoradh Lìonra Teasa: Dì-cheadaichte — feumar sealbhachadh gnìomhach iomchaidh.
disqualifications.heat_network_zero_net: Saoradh Lìonra Teasa: Cha deach a chur an sàs — tha buailteachd lom mar-thà air a lughdachadh gu £0.00.
disqualifications.heat_network_default: Saoradh Lìonra Teasa: Gun a bhith airidh fo riaghailtean reachdail.

disqualifications.public_lavatory_unoccupied: Public Lavatory Relief: Disqualified — requires qualifying occupation.
disqualifications.public_lavatory_zero_net: Public Lavatory Relief: Not applied — net liability already reduced to £0.00.
disqualifications.public_lavatory_default: Public Lavatory Relief: Not qualifying under statutory rules.

disqualifications.renewable_energy_rv_cap: Renewable Energy Generation Relief: Disqualified — Rateable Value (£{rv}) exceeds Scottish £1,000,000 statutory limit [SSI 2010/336].

disqualifications.renewable_energy_zero_net: Renewable Energy Generation Relief: Not applied — net liability already reduced to £0.00.
disqualifications.renewable_energy_default: Renewable Energy Generation Relief: Disqualified under scheme rules.

disqualifications.telecom_unoccupied: Faochadh Bun-structair Tele-chonaltradh: Dì-cheadaichte — feumar sealbhachadh gnìomhach iomchaidh.

disqualifications.ssbr_default: Supporting Small Business Relief: Not applicable — bill increase did not exceed statutory annual cap (£600/£800) over previous financial year [LGFA 1988 s.47].
disqualifications.empty_property_expired: Ùine Saor bho Ìrean Togalach Falamh: Dh'fhalbh an ùine — tha an ùine reachdail (3 mìosan malairteach / 6 mìosan gnìomhachais) seachad [Achd 1975 e.7A].
disqualifications.multiplier_wales_2027_provisional: Tha iomadairean na Cuimrigh airson 2027/28 nan tuairmsean sealach stèidhichte air luachan 2026/27 a' feitheamh ri reachdachadh riaghailtean reachdail.

ENGLAND.label: Sasainn
ENGLAND.description: Ìrean neo-dachaigheil reachdail fo Achd Ionmhais Riaghaltas Ionadail 1988 agus Achd nan Ìrean Neo-Dachaigheil 2023.

WALES.label: A' Chuimrigh
WALES.description: Ìrean tiomnaichte fo Achd Ionmhais Riaghaltas Ionadail (A' Chuimrigh) 2024 agus Innealan Reachdail na Cuimrigh.

SCOTLAND.label: Alba
SCOTLAND.description: Ìrean tiomnaichte fo Achd nan Ìrean Neo-Dachaigheil (Alba) 2020. Siostam iomadair trì-ìre agus SBBS.

CORPORATE.label: Buidheann Corporra / Companaidh
CORPORATE.description: Companaidh earranta (Ltd/PLC/LLP) buailteach airson ìrean neo-dachaigheil reachdail.

INDIVIDUAL.label: Neach Fa leth / Neach-malairt Aonar
INDIVIDUAL.description: Neach nàdarra, neach-malairt aonar, no com-pàirteachas neo-chorporra.

CHARITY.label: Carthannas Clàraichte
CHARITY.description: Carthannas clàraichte le OSCR/CC le còir air faochadh èigneachail 80% fo reachd.

CASC.label: CASC (Club Spòrs Neo-dhreuchdail Coimhearsnachd)
CASC.description: CASC clàraichte le HMRC a tha airidh air faochadh èigneachail 80%.

LOCAL_AUTHORITY.label: Ùghdarras Ionadail / Comhairle
LOCAL_AUTHORITY.description: Ùghdarras bileachaidh, comhairle baile, no buidheann poblach reachdail.

OCCUPIED.label: Gabhailte (Làn)
OCCUPIED.description: Tha an togalach air a ghabhail gu gnìomhach airson gnìomhachas.

UNOCCUPIED.label: Falamh / Gun Ghabhail
UNOCCUPIED.description: Tha an togalach falamh (buailteachd reachdail an sàs às deidh saoradh).

PART_OCCUPIED.label: Pàirt-ghabhailte (e.44A)
PART_OCCUPIED.description: Tha an togalach falamh gu sealach ann am pàirt, fo theisteanasan apportionment.

SBBS.label: Sgeama Bònas Ghnìomhachasan Beaga (Alba)
SBBS.description: Faochadh ìrean Albannach airson gnìomhachasan beaga suas gu £12,000/£11,500 RV.

SBRR.label: Faochadh Ìrean Gnìomhachais Bheaga (Sasainn)
SBRR.description: Lasachadh 100% suas gu £12,000 RV le teip loidhneach gu £15,000 RV.

CHARITY.label: Faochadh Carthannais Èigneachail
CHARITY.description: Faochadh èigneachail 80% fo LGFA 1988 e.43(5) no Achd 1962 e.4 airson adhbharan carthannach.

WALES_SBRR.label: Small Business Rate Relief (Wales)
WALES_SBRR.description: Faochadh 100% suas ri £6,000 RV, le lùghdachadh loidhneach gu £12,000 RV (cùram chloinne 100% gu £100,000 RV; oifis a' phuist 100%/50%) fo LGFA 1988 Clàr 4ZA para 4 / W.S.I. 2017/1229.

RHL.label: Retail, Hospitality & Leisure Relief
RHL.description: Statutory sector discount (40% in England 2025/26, expired 2026/27; 15% in Wales 2026/27; 15% mainland / 100% islands in Scotland 2026/27 up to £110,000 cash cap).

IMPROV.label: Improvement Relief (G-Factor)
IMPROV.description: 100% relief for 12 months on rateable value increases resulting from physical property improvements under NDRA 2023 (England).

EMPTY.label: Empty Property Exemption
EMPTY.description: 100% relief for initial 3 months (commercial) or 6 months (industrial) unoccupied periods under LGFA 1988 s.45.

RURAL.label: Rural Settlement Relief
RURAL.description: 100% mandatory relief for sole general stores, food shops, or post offices in designated rural settlements.

LAVATORY.label: Public Lavatories Relief
LAVATORY.description: 100% statutory rating exemption under Rating (Coronavirus and Public Lavatories) Act 2021.

HEAT_NET.label: Heat Network Relief
HEAT_NET.description: 100% relief for low-carbon district heating distribution hereditaments under NDRA 2023 (England).

WELSH_AVOIDANCE.label: Anti-Avoidance Statutory Penalty
WELSH_AVOIDANCE.description: Statutory penalty under Welsh Statutory Instrument 2026/43 (£500 fixed + 3% rateable value) for artificial avoidance.

SBBS_TR.label: Small Business Bonus Scheme Transitional Relief
SBBS_TR.description: Scottish statutory protection capping net bill increases for properties losing or seeing reduced SBBS (£600 in 2023/24 to £1,800 in 2025/26; 25% bill increase limit in 2026/27).

SSBR.label: Supporting Small Business Relief
SSBR.description: English statutory protection capping net bill increases for properties losing or seeing reduced SBRR, rural rate relief, or RHL relief (£600 annual increase cap in 2023–2025; £800 annual increase cap in 2026/27).

WALES_TR.label: Welsh Transitional Relief
WALES_TR.description: Statutory two-year transitional phasing scheme under W.S.I. 2025/1371 / W.S.I. 2022/1350 (67% relief on bill increases > £300 in Year 1, 34% in Year 2).

TELECOM.label: Telecommunications Infrastructure Relief
TELECOM.description: 100% statutory relief for new fibre telecommunications infrastructure under Telecommunications Infrastructure Act 2018 / SSI 2019/111.

CHARITY_TOPUP.label: Discretionary Charitable Relief Top-Up
CHARITY_TOPUP.description: Up to 20% discretionary top-up relief by billing authorities under LGFA 1988 s.47(2)(a) / 1962 Act s.4(5).

RENEWABLE.label: Renewable Energy Generation Relief
RENEWABLE.description: Tiered relief for renewable energy generation hereditaments under SSI 2010/336 (100% up to £145k RV, scaling to 10% up to £1m RV).

COUNCIL_TAX_TRANSFER.label: Council Tax Transfer (Holiday Let Disqualification)
COUNCIL_TAX_TRANSFER.description: Disqualification from non-domestic rating list where self-catering accommodation fails the statutory letting days test (Scotland from 2022/23: 70 days let, 140 available; Wales from 2023/24: 182 let, 252 available; England: 70 let, 140 available).

003.label: 003 - Airport / Major Aviation Infrastructure
003.description: Airport / high-value complex requiring standard national multiplier. Explicitly excluded from small business relief.

091.label: 091 - General Offices / Commercial Premises
091.description: Standard commercial office accommodation. Entitled to 3 months 100% empty property relief.

096.label: 096 - Industrial Hereditament / Warehouse / Factory
096.description: Industrial property qualifying for 6 months 100% empty property exemption under S.I. 2008/386.

209.label: 209 - Public House / Bar / Licensed Premises
209.description: Licensed premises eligible for Retail, Hospitality & Leisure (RHL) relief schemes.

211.label: 211 - Petrol Filling Station & Forecourt
211.description: Automotive fuel sales and forecourt shop. Explicitly excluded from retail discount in Wales under 2026/27 rules.

225.label: 225 - Retail Shop / High Street Unit
225.description: Standard retail shop or store eligible for SBRR and RHL discount schemes.

249.label: 249 - Self-Catering Holiday Accommodation
249.description: Holiday let subject to statutory minimum letting criteria (minimum 70 actual days let / 140 days available in Scotland).

084.label: 084 - Sgoil-àraich Latha / Crèche / Cùram Chloinne Clàraichte
084.description: Togalaichean air an cleachdadh gu tur airson cùram chloinne a tha freagarrach airson 100% SBRR suas ri £100,000 RV anns a' Chuimrigh fo W.S.I. 2017/1229 art. 8.

227.label: 227 - Oifis a' Phuist
227.description: Togalaichean oifis a' phuist a tha freagarrach airson 100% SBRR suas ri £9,000 RV agus faochadh 50% suas ri £12,000 RV anns a' Chuimrigh fo W.S.I. 2017/1229 art. 9.

024.label: 024 - Bothan Cladaich
024.description: Bothan cladaich. Air a thoirmeasg gu sònraichte bho fhaochadh reataichean gnìomhachasan beaga na Cuimrigh fo W.S.I. 2017/1229 art. 2.

050.label: 050 - Pàirceadh Chàraichean (Uachdar / Ioma-làr)
050.description: Togalaichean pàirceadh charbadan. Air an toirmeasg gu sònraichte bho fhaochadh reataichean gnìomhachasan beaga na Cuimrigh fo W.S.I. 2017/1229 art. 2.

027.label: 027 - Oifis Geall / Luchd-geall
027.description: Togalaichean geall. Air an dùnadh a-mach gu soilleir bho Sgeama Bònas Gnìomhachasan Beaga na h-Alba (SBBS) fo SSI 2023/30 riagh. 3(5).

SMALL_BUSINESS.label: Iomadair Gnothachais Bheag
SMALL_BUSINESS.description: Iomadair lùghdaichte airson gnìomhachasan beaga freagarrach.

HIGH_VALUE.label: Iomadair Àrd-luach
HIGH_VALUE.description: Iomadair rangachaidh nas àirde airson togalaichean àrd-luach (e.e. RV >= £500,000 ann an Sasainn).

SMALL_BUSINESS_RHL.label: Iomadair Gnothachais Bheag RHL
SMALL_BUSINESS_RHL.description: Iomadair lùghdaichte maireannach airson mion-reic, aoigheachd, cur-seachad fo £51k RV ann an Sasainn.

STANDARD_RHL.label: Iomadair Àbhaisteach RHL
STANDARD_RHL.description: Iomadair lùghdaichte maireannach airson mion-reic, aoigheachd, cur-seachad £51k-£500k RV ann an Sasainn.

RETAIL.label: Iomadair Mion-reic na Cuimrigh
